selector.rationale: The presence of macroglossia, hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate, purpuric macules, and scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining, along with a history of IgG λ-type multiple myeloma, strongly supports the diagnosis of Amyloidosis
